comment: Test vectors for deriving a journey id from an entity under a secret the host configures (docs/SDK_SPEC.md SDK-55, ADR-053). Computed independently of the Node SDK. An SDK that implements the derivation reproduces every one.

algorithm.key: the UTF-8 bytes of the secret, at least 32 bytes
algorithm.field: the 4-byte big-endian length of the UTF-8 bytes of the string, then those bytes
algorithm.label: journey-id/v1
algorithm.id: the prefix, then the first 32 lowercase hex characters (16 bytes) of the MAC

vectors.name: a job posting in production
vectors.secret: journey id test vector secret one, not a real key

refusedComment: Entities an SDK must not derive an id for: text that is not well-formed UTF-16 cannot be encoded as UTF-8 without replacing a code unit, so it would share an id with the replacement. Report it and return a random id.

refused.name: an id holding an unpaired surrogate
refused.secret: journey id test vector secret one, not a real key

refused.name: a type holding an unpaired surrogate
